Package neqsim.process.operations.replay

package neqsim.process.operations.replay
Time-series replay of a NeqSim ProcessSystem or ProcessModel driven by plant data.

ProcessReplay writes measured inputs through the ProcessAutomation facade, runs the model with a convergence gate for every time step, and records predicted outputs and residuals against measured tags. The ReplayResult summarises the run, computes window bias and RMS, baseline statistics, standardised residuals and CUSUM change points, and exports CSV or JSON.
